cohort: The study compared outcomes for patients receiving maternal care in operating rooms of a tertiary care hospital during pre-implementation (May-August 2024) and post-implementation (September-December 2024) phases of the LaQshya initiative.
finding: The implementation of the LaQshya initiative significantly improved maternal care outcomes by reducing adverse anesthesia events and drug stock-outs, while increasing patient satisfaction and WHO Safe Surgical Checklist compliance.
mod_finding: Adverse anesthesia events per 100 cesarean sections decreased from 7.3 to 2.3 after the LaQshya initiative implementation.
